1. The petitioner-wife seeks transfer of HMA No.1169/2020, titled Amit Kumar Mishra vs. Nancy Tiwari, filed by the respondent-husband under Section 13(1)(ia) & (ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act,

sentences.text: 2. The marriage between the parties was solemnized on 20.04.2018, but soon thereafter there arose some dispute between them and on 10.09.2018, the petitioner-wife is stated to have left her matrimonial home.
She filed a complaint before the police on 14.10.2018 alleging physical and mental torture.

This was followed by an FIR under Sections 498A, 406 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and then two more cases i.e., one under Section 12 of Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 and another petition under Section 125 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for the grant of maintenance.

sentences.text: 3. The respondent-husband, meanwhile, filed the subject petition seeking a decree of divorce.

4. The petitioner-wife seeks transfer primarily on the ground that she lives along with her brother in Buxar, which is 900 kms. away from Delhi and there is nobody in the family to accompany her as she has also lost her parents.

5. Upon notice, the respondent-husband has filed counter affidavit taking a plea that the petitioner-wife is working in the private sector at Gurugram and as such there will be no inconvenience caused to her in defending the divorce petition filed in Delhi.

This was followed by an FIR under Sections 498A, 406 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and then two more cases i.e., one under Section 12 of Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 and another petition under Section 125 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for the grant of maintenance.
